explanation: In a right triangle the three trig ratios are fixed once you know the angle θ — they don't depend on how big the triangle is. The angle slider tilts the hypotenuse, and the legs labeled opp (green) and adj (blue) update so that opp/hyp is always sin θ and adj/hyp is always cos θ. The hyp slider scales the whole triangle: notice the side lengths change but the printed sin, cos, and tan ratios stay the same — that constancy is the whole point of SOH-CAH-TOA.
bullets: SOH-CAH-TOA: Sin = Opp/Hyp, Cos = Adj/Hyp, Tan = Opp/Adj.
The ratios depend only on the angle, not on the triangle's size.
Scale the hypotenuse and the sides grow, but sin/cos/tan are unchanged.
